from.place: Local-lift Cech computation of the connecting boundary, via a compatible horseshoe resolution

title: Global horseshoe representative of the cohomology boundary
statement: Let X be a scheme with the indicated derived categories and enough injectives. Let S be a short exact sequence of module sheaves, and let IA, IB, IC be compatible injective resolutions with maps alpha, beta, alpha beta = 0, compatible augmentations and short exact rows. For every global section q of S.X3 there exist a global section b of IB^0 and a cycle a in Gamma(IA)^1 such that beta^0(b)=aug_C(q), alpha^1(a)=d b, and the resolution identification sends the canonical module cohomology boundary of toRightDerivedZero(q) to [a].

source.place: Tags 0117, 013T and 015B: snake boundary of a compatible resolution and derived triangle

proof.text: Obtain b, a and the two lifting equations from boundary_horseshoe_global_lift. Apply boundary_horseshoe_boundary_identification to those same b, a and equations, then assemble the existential and three conjuncts.

proof_origin.note: Second reader: separate lifting from the comparison with the canonical derived boundary. Existing signature unchanged.

mathlib_searches.query: A global lift in a horseshoe injective resolution represents the connecting cohomology class

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.ConcreteCategory δ_apply is the chain-level formula; transport through right derived and triangle identifications is still required.
HorseshoeDeltaFunctor, RightDerivedTriangleConnecting and InjectiveResolution.toRightDerivedZero_eq provide the ingredients; no bundled sheaf global representative theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem boundary_horseshoe_representative (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))]
    [EnoughInjectives X.Modules]
    [EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [(RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).Additive]
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    (IA : InjectiveResolution S.X₁) (IB : InjectiveResolution S.X₂)
    (IC : InjectiveResolution S.X₃)
    (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ IB.cocomplex) (β : IB.cocomplex ⟶ IC.cocomplex)
    (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0)
    (hιA : IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).map S.f ≫ IB.ι)
    (hιB : IB.ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).map S.g ≫ IC.ι)
    (hrows : ∀ k : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      (HomologicalComplex.eval X.Modules (ComplexShape.up ℕ) k)).ShortExact)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (q : S.X₃.val.obj (op ⊤)) :
    ∃ (b : (IB.cocomplex.X 0).val.obj (op ⊤))
      (a : (RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex IA).cycles 1),
      (β.f 0).val.app (op ⊤) b = (IC.ι.f 0).val.app (op ⊤) q ∧
      (α.f 1).val.app (op ⊤)
        ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex IA).iCycles 1 a) =
          (IB.cocomplex.d 0 1).val.app (op ⊤) b ∧
      (IA.isoRightDerivedObj (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) 1).hom
        (RingedSpace.moduleCohomologyBoundary X.toRingedSpace S hS 0
          ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).toRightDerivedZero.app S.X₃ q)) =
        (RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex IA).homologyπ 1 a
